title: 10th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/10/3/2025).

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Islamic Affairs, Dr Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed: the B. Kendhoo Friday mosque, contracted on 13 September 2023 under the previous government for completion in 365 days, remains unfinished; why is it so delayed, what is being done to speed it up, and when will it open?

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Islamic Affairs, Dr Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed: the Hajj Corporation announced it will enter the tourist hotel business, which the minister said he was unaware of and disapproved; did he act to stop it, what did he do, and if not, will he?

From the Speaker's desk: the matter of appointing the President of the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Commission under Article 22(a) of Law No. 16/2025 (Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Act) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

First reading of the resolution submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to determine members' view on the government delaying flat handovers to many of the 4,000 beneficiaries of the Gedhoruveriya scheme, leaving reclamation at Gulhifalhu, Giraavarufalhu and Hulhumalé Phase 3 under the first Binveriya scheme unfinished, and ignoring the rights of applicants for Hulhumalé flats and Uthuru Thilafalhu land under the second Gedhoruveriya/Binveriya scheme while prioritising the Ras Malé project, costing thousands of Maldivians their right to housing.

Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to determine members' view on foreigners married to Maldivians and living in the Maldives not receiving Aasandha health insurance services.
Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the Bill amending Law No. 24/2014 (Special Economic Zones Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Islamic Minister on the Kendhoo mosque and Hajj Corporation hotels, introduce a housing resolution, debate Aasandha cover for foreign spouses, and continue the Special Economic Zones amendment debate.
